name: bollinger
summary: This EA trades based on Bollinger Bands indicators, entering long positions when price touches or breaks below the lower band and entering short positions when price touches or breaks above the upper band, expecting mean reversion to the middle band. It uses the standard Bollinger Bands calculation with configurable period and deviation parameters. The EA systematically opens and closes trades based on band interaction signals.
summary_zh: 该EA基于布林带指标进行交易，当价格触及或突破下轨时做多，当价格触及或突破上轨时做空，预期价格将回归中轨。使用标准布林带计算方法，支持自定义周期和偏差参数。EA根据价格与布林带轨线的交互信号系统性地开仓和平仓。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于布林带均值回归原理，认为价格偏离布林带中轨后倾向于回归。入场条件为：当价格触及或跌破下轨时买入开多，当价格触及或升破上轨时卖出开空。出场条件通常包括价格回到中轨时平仓，或触及对侧轨道时平仓。仓位管理可能采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例仓位。资金管理方面，EA可能包含止损设置但也可能仅依赖布林带轨道作为隐性止损。该策略在震荡行情中表现较好，但在强趋势行情中可能连续亏损。部分布林带EA还会结合成交量或其他指标作为过滤条件以减少假信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Bollinger Bands mean reversion principle, assuming that prices tend to revert to the mean after deviating from the middle band. Entry conditions: buy when price touches or breaks below the lower band, sell when price touches or breaks above the upper band. Exit conditions typically include closing positions when price returns to the middle band or reaches the opposite band. Position sizing may use fixed lots or account-balance-based proportional sizing. Money management may include stop-loss settings but could also rely on Bollinger Band levels as implicit stops. The strategy performs well in ranging markets but may suffer consecutive losses during strong trending conditions. Some Bollinger Band EAs incorporate volume or additional indicators as filters to reduce false signals.

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 to disable

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, 0 to disable

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于识别本EA的订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying its orders

pros: 布林带是成熟可靠的技术指标，策略逻辑清晰易懂
均值回归策略在震荡市中表现稳健，胜率较高
参数可调性强，交易者可根据不同品种和周期优化布林带参数
pros_en: Bollinger Bands is a well-established and reliable technical indicator with clear strategy logic
Mean reversion strategy performs steadily in ranging markets with a relatively high win rate
Highly configurable parameters allow traders to optimize BB settings for different instruments and timeframes
cons: 在强趋势行情中可能连续亏损，价格沿轨道运行导致逆势交易
缺少明确的止损设置可能导致单笔亏损过大
未考虑交易成本和滑点，在实际交易中均值回归的空间可能被点差侵蚀
cons_en: May suffer consecutive losses during strong trends as price can walk along the band edge causing counter-trend entries
Lack of explicit stop-loss can lead to excessive single-trade losses
Does not account for trading costs and slippage; mean reversion profit targets may be eroded by spreads in live trading
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如ADX或均线方向），在强趋势时暂停交易或切换为趋势跟踪策略
添加明确的止损止盈设置和仓位管理规则，控制最大回撤
结合成交量或RSI等辅助指标确认信号有效性，减少假突破导致的亏损交易
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., ADX or MA direction) to pause trading or switch to trend-following during strong trends
Implement explicit stop-loss/take-profit settings and position sizing rules to control maximum drawdown
Combine with volume or RSI as confirming indicators to improve signal reliability and reduce losses from false breakouts

risk_points: 缺少止损或止损设置不当可能导致单笔大额亏损
趋势行情中逆势交易会连续亏损
仓位管理可能不够完善，未考虑账户整体风险暴露
risk_points_en: Missing or inadequate stop-loss can lead to large single-trade losses
Counter-trend entries during trending markets can result in consecutive losses
Position sizing may be insufficient, not considering overall account risk exposure
